protocol.source_failure: foot_motion: 90 N +y wrist pulse 4.5–4.8 s, left sole displacement 78.460 mm; foot_model_transfer filter reduced it to 0.304 mm
protocol.hypothesis: A first-command executable cone feasibility guard at release prevents loss of support and permits a low-motion braced abort when feet-only return is unavailable.
protocol.baseline: Existing executable-torque filter, +20 mm reach command at 4 s, feet-only scheduled return at 5.2 s
protocol.correction: Same controller through 5.2 s; reject feet-only command if projection fails, then solve toward current estimated braced posture with zero reference velocity
protocol.falsification: Guard must finish supported at rest in both cases, with no worse post-release sole displacement than baseline. Standing recovery is scored separately and is required for a complete cycle.
protocol.assumptions: 20 mm target change and success screens are task-scale simulation assumptions; no hardware ranges measured. Same seed-17 estimated pose errors and ideal joint/velocity channels.
